PREMIERE316 STYLE-ONLY IMAGE REFERENCE CONTROL — V2
Asset ID: loc-inner-chamber-transformed
Workflow profile: 2P39X1 (2.39:1)
Reference mode: ART DIRECTION ONLY — NO SUBJECT OR DESIGN TRANSFER.

The loaded images are non-content style plates. The asset prompt below is the sole authority for subject, identity, age, ethnicity, anatomy, wardrobe design, prop design, environment geometry, creatures, crowd population, pose, action, camera composition, wounds, blood placement, text, and all story content.

ALLOWED TRANSFER ONLY: overall palette; contrast curve; key/fill/rim relationship; volumetric-light behavior; atmosphere density; material highlight and shadow response; lens/exposure language; practical texture fidelity; cinematic depth; restrained film grain.

FORBIDDEN TRANSFER: faces or facial geometry; body identity or proportions; hairstyles; costume silhouettes; wounds or blood maps; weapons or props; architecture or set geography; creature designs; crowd layout; pose; framing; four-panel layout; lettering; logos; or any recognizable object from a reference, unless the asset prompt itself explicitly requests that exact element.

Location guard: transfer only color, light behavior, haze, scale language, and material realism. Do not copy the reference cave, Hell gate, fortress geometry, crowds, or blocking unless this row explicitly requires those elements.

Active plate roles: warm-gold lighting and highlight rolloff; smoky umber shadow palette and ember atmosphere; abstract filmic tonal/material response and restrained grain.
When a reference conflicts with the row prompt, ignore the reference and obey the row prompt.

AUTHORITATIVE ASSET PROMPT
--------------------------
HELL'S INNER CHAMBER, TRANSFORMED STATE — PRODUCTION REFERENCE: CINEMATIC ENVIRONMENT, SCALE, LIGHTING, MATERIALS, AND CONTINUITY.

Photorealistic live-action production reference, physically coherent lighting, exact anatomy, clean hands, consistent scale and materials, no captions, no logos, no watermarks, no borders, and no written or graphical elements.

RICH PHOTOREALISTIC LOCATION DETAIL LOCK
---------------------------------------
The generated image must feel like a final live-action cinema plate, not a loose concept sketch. Fill the frame with physically believable environmental detail at foreground, midground, and background depth: chipped stone edges, fractured strata, mineral veins, soot stains, ash drifts, dust settled into cracks, rough tool marks, eroded masonry, scorch halos around heat sources, subtle moisture or polished wear where appropriate, and tiny atmospheric particles catching the light. Preserve coherent perspective, grounded gravity, readable scale relationships, and material continuity across every surface.

Use photorealistic lens behavior: natural 2.39:1 cinematic composition unless the workflow is vertical, deep but controlled atmospheric perspective, realistic depth of field, restrained anamorphic character, high dynamic range, natural motion-free stillness, no over-sharpened CGI sheen, no painterly brush texture, no miniature look, no plastic surfaces, no generic fantasy castle shortcuts. Lighting must be physically motivated by visible practical sources, divine shafts, embers, torches, sky glow, or bounce light; every highlight should have a plausible source and every shadow should wrap naturally around form.

Location richness requirement: the environment should be independently useful as a production reference. Include enough readable architecture, terrain, negative space, texture hierarchy, and weathering to support multiple later shots. Avoid empty backgrounds, flat walls, smooth generic floors, duplicated decorative patterns, random symmetry, collage layouts, title text, labels, captions, borders, watermarks, modern objects, modern lighting rigs, and any graphic design elements. If characters or souls are described by the specific asset prompt, keep them secondary to the location geography and integrate them naturally into the physical space.

Ultra-wide cinematic production plate of Hell's Inner Chamber in its final transformed state after the sword shockwave has remade the fortress from prison into sanctified hall. This is the completed metamorphosis—not mid-collapse, not residual darkness winning—when black stone has fully become white marble, blue torch fire has become golden fire, and poison air has become warm perfume light.

Architecture and scale: a vast underground cathedral-cavern approximately five hundred feet deep by four hundred feet wide, ceiling rising nearly three hundred feet, now fully visible rather than lost in smoke. Forty-eight monumental support columns stand in a regular grid; each column has transmuted from corroded black basalt into polished white Carrara-like marble veined with soft gold and warm cream, surfaces catching specular highlights along fluted shafts and broad capitals. Floor planes are seamless white marble with subtle gold inlay seams where former fracture lines healed into luminous geometry. Residual broken chain links and fallen corroded iron manacles lie scattered in heaps between pillars—instruments of bondage discarded after the mass simultaneous release—resting on clean marble without staining the stone dark. Where endless chain grids once suspended ten thousand souls at six-foot vertical intervals, only empty bronze-dark rings and snapped links remain, some still dangling short from high vault fixtures as silent evidence of liberation.

Lighting and flame conversion: every torch sconce that once burned cold royal-blue hellfire now burns pure golden fire—warm amber-gold flames (#FFD700 to #FFBF00) with soft white cores, steady and sacred rather than hungry. Torchlight pools warm across marble floors and climbs columns in gentle gradients. Dominant key light is divine: volumetric god rays of ethereal gold and pure white radiance flooding inward from the shattered gate breach at one end of the hall and from a newly opened vertical path of light in the upper vault. Color temperature balances near natural warm 4500K with golden highlights near 6500K in the brightest rays; soft residual cool blue is only a faint memory in the deepest distant niches, nearly erased. No oppressive crimson underglow remains. Atmosphere reads as perfume and warm amber haze: fine luminous dust motes and light ash suspended in shafts of gold, fragrant rather than toxic, smoke thinned to translucent incense-like veils that catch volumetric rays.

Staircase of light: at the far upper reach of the chamber, a path of pure white-and-gold luminous steps opens upward through the transformed vault toward heaven—architectural light made solid enough to walk, each tread radiating soft divinity without hard neon edges. The staircase begins on the chamber floor as a luminous breach in reality and ascends out of frame, suggesting infinite elevation and return to life. Freed righteous souls appear only as small distant scale figures near the staircase base and mid-aisle—pale human forms in rough ancient garments, no longer chained, standing or beginning to process toward the light—kept small and non-hero so the environment remains the subject. Do not place readable faces as the primary focus; use crowd scale only.

Material truth: marble shows physical weight, polish, and subsurface translucency at edges; gold fire behaves like real flame with heat shimmer above sconces; discarded chains retain iron corrosion, dried blood-dark residue, and bone-adjacent fittings consistent with Hell's iron-and-bone craft, now powerless on the floor. Pillar shadows are soft and short under multi-directional warm fill. Ceiling vaults are white stone coffers and ribbing previously black, now illuminated from below by golden fire and from above by the staircase breach.

Camera and grade: 2.39:1 anamorphic cinematic widescreen, approximately 24–35mm wide lens, slightly low heroic angle looking deep into the hall toward the staircase of light and the gate-side light flood, deep focus enough to read architecture while soft falloff at extreme distance, physically coherent live-action film lighting. Color grade: balanced warm biblical-epic palette—white marble, gold fire, warm amber air, soft cream highlights, minimal cool remnant. Photoreal live-action biblical epic production still, reverent sacred tone, monumental scale, no modern objects, no electric fixtures, no cameras, no crew, no logos, no captions, no watermarks, no borders, no written or graphical elements, no text overlays, no UI, no anime or illustration look. Continuity lock: this plate is the final transformed inner chamber after Jesus strikes the ground with the sword of light—marble, golden fire, perfume air, staircase of light open—ready for the procession "Come with me."

ADDITIONAL LOCATION SPECIFICITY
-------------------------------
This is the same prison geography after rupture and transformation. Preserve the floor plan and pillars from the dark chamber, but show the threshold changed by divine arrival: broken iron and bone gate fragments, golden light spilling through smoke, ash lifting from the floor, chains slack or shattered, black stone beginning to reveal pale mineral veining, old soot washed by warm illumination, and shadow pockets retreating into the edges. It should feel like a physical set mid-transfiguration, not an abstract glow effect.
